column20: There are many things I'm learning for the first time, so some parts are difficult, but it's a lot of fun.

column19: 自分が知っている文法や単語を上手く使って文章を考える時間は大変だけど楽しいから
column20: Because thinking up sentences by making good use of the grammar and words I know is hard work, but fun.

column19: 主語によって動詞が変化するかが難しいと感じることがある

column19: 文法によって使う動詞が変わるのが難しい

column19: 語順を覚えればこれからもっと書けるようになると思います。

column19: 文の語順、文法は比較的簡単ですが、単語力がないため作文が書けない
column20: Sentence word order and grammar are relatively easy, but I can't write compositions because I lack vocabulary.

column19: 単語力がもう少し身についていれば簡単に書けると思う
column20: I think I could write easily if I had built up a little more vocabulary.

column19: 日本語と語順が違うから
column20: Because the word order is different from Japanese.

column19: わからない単語がまだ多いから
column20: Because there are still many words I don't know.

column19: 動詞の活用が難しいと感じるから
column20: Because I find verb conjugation difficult.

column19: 単語が書けないことが多いから。活用が難しいと感じるから。
column20: Because there are often words I can't write. Because I find conjugation difficult.

column19: まだまだ知らない単語が多く、毎回調べてしまっているから。自分で文章を書くと同じフレーズしか使えていないと感じる。
column20: Because there are still many words I don't know, and I end up looking them up every time. When I write sentences myself, I feel I can only use the same phrases.

column19: 初めて学習する言語だから。
column20: Because it's a language I'm learning for the first time.

column19: 分からない単語が多いため
column20: Because there are many words I don't know.

column19: インドネシア語特有の文法があるため
column20: Because there is grammar unique to Indonesian.

column19: だいたいの文章において、日本語とは逆に書けば良いから。
column20: Because for most sentences, you just have to write them in the opposite order to Japanese.

column19: 日本語と反対の順序で大体の文章は書くことやじできるから。
column20: Because I can write most sentences in the reverse order of Japanese.

column19: 語順が分からなくなることがあるから
column20: Because I sometimes lose track of the word order.

column19: 英語や日本語と違うインドネシア語のルールがあるため
column20: Because Indonesian has rules that differ from English and Japanese.

column19: 作文をすることは好きだから。また、インドネシア語の勉強になるため
column20: Because I like writing compositions. Also, because it helps me study Indonesian.

column19: それほど難しいと感じないから
column20: Because I don't find it that difficult.

column19: 学んだ単語や文法を使ったり、学んだことがつながったりするため
column20: Because I get to use the words and grammar I've learned, and the things I've learned connect with each other.

column19: 思ったことをインドネシア語に変換しているときの難しいなと感じる感覚が好きだから
column20: Because I like the feeling of "this is hard" when I'm converting what I think into Indonesian.

column19: 学び始めたばかりなので、単語がすぐ出てこなかったり、文法が難しいから。
column20: Because I've only just started learning, so words don't come to me right away, and the grammar is difficult.

column19: まだ、知らない単語が多く、表現の仕方に困る時があるから
column20: Because there are still many words I don't know, and I sometimes struggle with how to express things.

column19: 単語や文法、動詞の語用などを気をつけなければいけないから
column20: Because I have to pay attention to vocabulary, grammar, verb usage, and so on.

column19: 日本語では、言葉がスラスラ出てくるがインドネシア語で書こうとすると手が止まってしまうから
column20: Because in Japanese the words flow out smoothly, but when I try to write in Indonesian, my hand stops.

column19: 単語がすぐに出てこない場合が多い、加えて英語と混ざることが多い
column20: Words often don't come to me right away, and on top of that I often mix them up with English.

column19: 文法の順番が日本語と違うので混乱する
column20: The grammatical order is different from Japanese, so I get confused.

column19: 文法が日本語とは異なるため、文の組み立てが難しいときがある。単語がわからない
column20: The grammar is different from Japanese, so constructing sentences is sometimes difficult. I don't know the words.

column19: 少しずつ文法の仕組みが理解できるようになって、文の組み立てができるようになってきたから
column20: Because I've gradually come to understand how the grammar works and have become able to construct sentences.

column19: me-kanやme-, ber- など、ルールが多いので文を書く時に混乱してしまうときがあるから、簡単ではない。
column20: There are many rules, like me-kan, me-, and ber-, so I sometimes get confused when writing sentences; it's not easy.

column19: 英語よりは楽だと感じるため
column20: Because I feel it's easier than English.

column19: 基本的に日本語分を後ろから訳すとかけるので、とても難しいとは今の段階では思わない。
column20: Basically you can write it by translating the Japanese sentence from the back, so at this stage I don't think it's very difficult.

column19: 簡単な文章しかまだ書けないから。受身など実際の作文で使って書いたことがまだないから
column20: Because I can still only write simple sentences. Because I haven't yet used things like the passive voice in actual compositions.

column19: 語順が複雑ではないから。接周辞や接尾辞が難しい
column20: Because the word order isn't complicated. Circumfixes and suffixes are difficult.

column19: 日本語や英語よりも語形変化の種類が多く、使いこなすのは難しいから。
column20: Because there are more kinds of word-form changes than in Japanese or English, and mastering them is difficult.

column19: 知っている単語の数が少ないから。文法語順が難しいことがあるから
column20: Because I know only a small number of words. Because grammar and word order are sometimes difficult.

column19: まだわからない単語が多いから
column20: Because there are still many words I don't know.

column19: 単語の語形変化が難しいから
column20: Because word-form changes are difficult.

column19: まだまだ知らない単語や、文法で勘違いしている部分があったりするから
column20: Because there are still many words I don't know and parts of the grammar I've misunderstood.

column19: 基本的な文章を書くことには慣れてきたけれど、単語量や文章量が多いと難しい。
column20: I've gotten used to writing basic sentences, but it's difficult when there's a lot of vocabulary or a lot of text.

column19: 日本語で考えた文章と少し変えないと伝わりにくいので難しく感じます
column20: It feels difficult because I have to change the sentence I thought of in Japanese a bit, or it won't get across.

column19: 使える単語が増えてきたので以前よりは書くのが簡単になりましたが、まだ文法も単語も覚えていない部分があるため
column20: The number of words I can use has increased, so writing is easier than before, but there are still parts of the grammar and vocabulary I haven't memorized.

column19: 長い作文を書くことは難しいですが、あまり長すぎない作文であれば書けるから。
column20: Because writing long compositions is difficult, but I can write compositions that aren't too long.

column19: SVOCの語順が英語と似ており、その点では簡単だが、インドネシア語の単語をほぼ知らないため、書きたいことが書くことができない。
column20: The SVOC word order is similar to English, so it's easy in that respect, but I know almost no Indonesian words, so I can't write what I want to write.

column19: 知っている単語で文を書くことができるようになってきた
column20: I've become able to write sentences using the words I know.

column19: I can make short story or dairy using easy words.
column20: I can make short story or dairy using easy words.

column19: 簡単な単語での作文はできる
column20: I can write compositions using simple words.

column19: ボキャブラリーが圧倒的に少ない
column20: My vocabulary is overwhelmingly small.

column19: まだ文法や単語の知識が不十分なので、書きづらい。
column20: My knowledge of grammar and vocabulary is still insufficient, so it's hard to write.

column19: インドネシア語の知識がまだ浅いため、作文を作る時には必ず辞書がないと書けないため
column20: Because my knowledge of Indonesian is still shallow, I can't write compositions without a dictionary.

column19: 難しい単語や語句を使う表現が条件の作文は少し難しいと感じるから。
column20: Because it feels a bit difficult when the composition requires expressions using difficult words or phrases.

column19: 文法がまだ覚えられていないのと単語の知識が浅いから
column20: Because I haven't memorized the grammar yet and my knowledge of vocabulary is shallow.

column19: 単語と文法の知識が乏しいうえ、書いた経験が少ないので苦戦してしまう。
column20: My knowledge of vocabulary and grammar is poor, and on top of that I have little experience writing, so I struggle.

column19: どの言語でも言えることだが、思っている事を文にすることはむずかしい。文法力が足りない
column20: This is true of any language, but it's difficult to put what you're thinking into sentences. My grammar skills are lacking.

column19: 一年前よりかは知識も増え、多少書きやすくなったが、まだ力不足な部分が多く、書きたいものよりも書けるものを優先してしまう
column20: Compared with a year ago, my knowledge has grown and it's become somewhat easier to write, but there are still many areas where my skills fall short, and I end up prioritizing what I can write over what I want to write.

column19: 伝えたいことがあっても単語や表現方法がわからないことが多いから
column20: Because even when there's something I want to convey, I often don't know the words or how to express it.

column19: 語順が難しく感じる。単語の意味や使い方がまだあまり分からないから。
column20: Word order feels difficult. Because I still don't really understand the meanings and usage of words.

column19: 言いたい表現をインドネシア語で言う（書く）のはとても難かしいと感じる。なぜなら語いをあまり知らないから
column20: I find it very difficult to say (write) what I want to express in Indonesian, because I don't know much vocabulary.

column19: 難しさは自分で決める事ができると思うから
column20: Because I think difficulty is something you can decide for yourself.

column19: 他の言語に比べて簡単だと思うけど、日本語をインドネシア語で考えたりするのは、やはり難しいと感じる。
column20: I think it's easier than other languages, but thinking of Japanese in Indonesian still feels difficult.

column19: インドネシア語学習を始めてまだ１カ月くらいなので、単語が分からず、難しいですが、楽しいです。
column20: I've only been studying Indonesian for about a month, so I don't know the words and it's difficult, but it's fun.

column19: インドネシア語の語彙が少なすぎるので自分の伝えたいことがうまく書き出せない
column20: My Indonesian vocabulary is too small, so I can't write out what I want to convey well.

column19: 自分のインドネシア語のボキャブラリーが少ないから
column20: Because my Indonesian vocabulary is small.

column19: 語彙力がないので、辞書などが必要だから時間がかかる
column20: Because I don't have much vocabulary, I need a dictionary and so on, so it takes time.

column19: ボキャブラリーが多くないため,表現したいことを書くのに時間がかかるから
column20: Because my vocabulary isn't large, it takes time to write what I want to express.

column19: 英語のような複雑な文法がなく、単語をうまく組合すことができれば、伝えたい大まかな内容を表現することができるから。
column20: Because there's no complicated grammar like in English, and if you can combine words well, you can express the general content you want to convey.

column19: 英語よりも単語が覚えやすく、文法も分かりやすいため、日本語で文を作ってからインドネシア語に翻訳するのが容易だから
column20: Because the words are easier to memorize than in English and the grammar is easy to understand, so it's easy to make a sentence in Japanese and then translate it into Indonesian.

column19: 日本語での作文の力をそのまま活かせるから
column20: Because I can use my composition skills in Japanese as they are.

column19: 個人的には、英語よりも使う言葉を選ぶ必要が少ないため、かなり楽に感じる。
column20: Personally, I feel it's quite easy, because there's less need to choose which words to use than in English.

column19: 知らない単語が多いのと、men、pemなど動詞や名詞にいつ付けるのか、付けるとどうなるのかわからないから。
column20: Because there are many words I don't know, and I don't understand when to attach men, pem, etc. to verbs and nouns, or what happens when you attach them.

column19: 話し言葉と書き言葉の差が大きい
column20: The gap between spoken and written language is large.

column19: 言葉使い、メールを書くときのマナーを知らない為
column20: Because I don't know the proper wording or the etiquette for writing emails.

column19: 簡単な作文程度ならつくれるが、難しい文章は少し難しいです。
column20: I can make simple compositions, but difficult sentences are a bit hard.

column19: 文法があっているのかがまだわからない
column20: I still can't tell whether my grammar is correct.

column19: 文法やスペルなど様々なところに注意して書くので時間がかかるし正答率が低いと思う
column20: I pay attention to many things like grammar and spelling when writing, so it takes time, and I think my accuracy is low.

column19: 語彙力と文法知識が圧倒的に不足しているため。
column20: Because my vocabulary and grammar knowledge are overwhelmingly lacking.

column19: 単語の活用の変化がとても難しいです。どうしても単語を考えたりする際、使い慣れている英語が浮かんでしまい、また単語力が乏しいからです
column20: Changes in word inflection are very difficult. When I think of words, English, which I'm used to, inevitably comes to mind, and also my vocabulary is poor.

column19: 語彙力が乏しいので書きたい文章をうまく書けず表現が上手くできないため

column20: Because the difference between kan and i is difficult.

column20: I can understand words, but I'm not at the level of writing compositions.

column19: まだ単語や文法を選べないことがあり、ミスが出てきてしまうため。そして単語の知識が不十分であるため。
column20: Because there are still times when I can't choose the right word or grammar, and mistakes come up. Also because my knowledge of vocabulary is insufficient.

column19: ボキャブラリー知識が劣っており、かける文章が限られているから。
column20: Because my vocabulary knowledge is poor and the sentences I can write are limited.

column19: 作文の内容にもよるが、日常的な内容についての作文だと簡単に書くことができるため。
column20: It depends on the content of the composition, but I can write easily if the composition is about everyday topics.

column19: インドネシア語を習って1カ月ですが、会話をすることは相手に伝わればよいと感じますが、作文だと簡単な単語でも長い分を作らなくてはいけないのでとても難しいです。
column20: I've been learning Indonesian for one month; in conversation I feel it's fine as long as the other person understands, but in compositions you have to make long sentences even with simple words, so it's very difficult.

column19: 動詞の変化が難しい
column20: Verb changes are difficult.

column19: 文法が単純で分かりやすく、単語も覚えやすいため。
column20: Because the grammar is simple and easy to understand, and the words are easy to memorize.

column19: 約４年弱学習を続けており、現地への留学経験もあるので簡単な作文であれば容易に書くことができるため
column20: I've been studying for just under four years and have also studied abroad there, so I can easily write simple compositions.

column19: 英語よりも文法が簡単だから
column20: Because the grammar is easier than English.

column19: 自動詞と他動詞の違いや、me-i,me-kanの違いをかき分けることが難しいです。似た単語のニュアンスの違いも難しいです。
column20: It's difficult to distinguish between intransitive and transitive verbs, and between me-i and me-kan, in writing. The differences in nuance between similar words are also difficult.

column19: 母国語ではないから
column20: Because it's not my native language.

column19: 口語と文語が混ざるから。動詞のkanとiの使い分けが難しいから
column20: Because colloquial and written language get mixed. Because using kan and i correctly with verbs is difficult.

column19: 交互で使われるインドネシア語とは異なり、正しい文法で書くのが難しいから
column20: Because unlike the Indonesian used in exchanges [conversation], it's difficult to write with correct grammar.

column19: 書き言葉と話し言葉で使う表現が異なるため
column20: Because the expressions used in written language and spoken language are different.

column19: 単語量の少なさや文法での不明瞭な点がまだ多くあるため
column20: Because my vocabulary is small and there are still many unclear points in the grammar.

column19: 語順や、どの文法を使うのかのっ判別が難しい
column20: It's difficult to determine the word order and which grammar to use.

column19: フォーマルな言葉と会話で使う言葉の使い分けが難しい。細かい文法などが難しい
column20: It's difficult to distinguish between formal language and the language used in conversation. The detailed grammar is difficult.

column19: 母国語ではないためニュアンスや言い方、使い方がとても難しい。
column20: Because it's not my native language, nuances, phrasing, and usage are very difficult.

column19: me動詞、ber動詞の使い分け、前置詞の使い分けなどのミスが多いなと自覚しています。
column20: I'm aware that I make many mistakes, such as using me- verbs vs. ber- verbs, and choosing prepositions.

column19: 時制があまりしっかりしていないイメージなので、相手に正しく読み取ってもらうのが難しいイメージがあります
column20: My impression is that tense isn't very clearly defined, so I imagine it's difficult to get the reader to interpret it correctly.

column19: テーマによって書けるかかけないかが分かれるから。単語数や文法には問題ない。
column20: Because whether I can write or not depends on the theme. Vocabulary and grammar are not a problem.

column19: まだ自分の言いたい表現をうまくかける自信がないから
column20: Because I'm still not confident that I can write the expressions I want to say well.

column19: 接尾字や接頭語を間違えて使ってしまうと、意味が変わってしまうから
column20: Because if you use suffixes or prefixes incorrectly, the meaning changes.

column19: 文法的なルールを意識しなくても伝わる文章が書けるからです.。　 例えば過去形などが難しくないので簡単だと思います.

column19: 単語と文法が難しいから
column20: Because the words and grammar are difficult.

column19: me-kanやme-iなど文章か後ろの文脈によって変化するのでそこが難しいです
column20: Things like me-kan and me-i change depending on the sentence and the context that follows, so that's what's difficult.

column19: 日本語をインドネシア語に直すのが難しい。
column20: Converting Japanese into Indonesian is difficult.

column19: 単語が難しい
column20: The words are difficult.

column19: 留学期間のライティングの授業のおかげで以前よりは早く書けるようになったと思います.
column20: I think I've become able to write faster than before thanks to the writing classes during my study abroad.

column19: 語順や、他動詞自動詞の変化が難しい
column20: Word order and the changes between transitive and intransitive verbs are difficult.

column19: 受け身やme-kan, me-i語順が難しく感じる
column20: The passive voice, me-kan, me-i, and word order feel difficult.

column19: 単語の知識不足と文法の勉強不足
column20: Lack of vocabulary knowledge and insufficient study of grammar.

column19: 単語がわからない
column20: I don't know the words.

column19: 基本的な文法は日本語と似ていて学習しやすいが、単語の活用や単語を覚えるのが難しい
column20: The basic grammar is similar to Japanese and easy to learn, but word inflection and memorizing words are difficult.

column19: 口語表現が混ざってしまうことがある。フォーマルなインドネシア語は文法がむずかしいと感じることがある
column20: Colloquial expressions sometimes get mixed in. I sometimes find the grammar of formal Indonesian difficult.

column19: yangの後の受動態が一人称、二人称、三人称で語順や動詞の形が変わるため
column20: Because in passives after yang, the word order and verb form change depending on first, second, or third person.

column19: 英語ほど難しくはないとは思いますが、（時制で動詞の変化が多くないため）me動詞として使う時にそれぞれの単語ごとの形が分からなくなる時があります
column20: I don't think it's as difficult as English (because verbs don't change much with tense), but when using words as me- verbs, I sometimes lose track of the form for each word.

column19: 日本語と表現が全く違うが、英語で考えると少し書きやすくなるから。また、単語も英語に似ているものがある
column20: The expressions are completely different from Japanese, but thinking in English makes it a bit easier to write. Also, some words are similar to English.

column19: 話し言葉と混ざってしまうから。知らない単語が多く、調べるのに時間がかかるから
column20: Because it gets mixed with spoken language. Because there are many words I don't know and it takes time to look them up.

column19: 伝えたい日本語のニュアンスを訳すのが難しい時があるから
column20: Because it's sometimes difficult to translate the Japanese nuance I want to convey.

column19: いつも学校で習う単語とはまた違った語彙が必要だから、苦手意識があるから
column20: Because it requires vocabulary different from the words we usually learn at school, and I feel I'm not good at it.

column19: 辞書を使わないと正確な文を作るのが難しい
column20: It's difficult to make accurate sentences without using a dictionary.

column19: 文法と自制がわかりやすいから
column20: Because the grammar and tense are easy to understand.

column19: 単語がわかれば大体書けるから
column20: Because if you know the words, you can write most things.

column19: インドネシア語は世界一簡単な言語と言われるほどシンプルでわかりやすいから
column20: Because Indonesian is so simple and easy to understand that it's said to be the easiest language in the world.

column19: 単語がまだ難しいから
column20: Because the words are still difficult.

column19: 最近は少しずつ理解して簡単にはなってきてるけど難しい。
column20: Recently I've gradually come to understand it and it's gotten easier, but it's difficult.

column19: 語彙が少なく文法構造をあまり理解していないから
column20: Because my vocabulary is small and I don't understand the grammatical structure very well.

column19: まだ学び始めたばかりだから
column20: Because I've only just started learning.
